fusions.name: Canopy Drop
fusions.desc: Slams the target for 15 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 4% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 40%.

fusions.name: The Troop Throws
fusions.desc: Hurls a stone at the first enemy in line that deals 7 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%. It holds 3 charges, and each kill returns one.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Kill Display
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
